procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
GER 3457 was represented in the hearing by Maiken Fromm (helm).
IND 3407 was represented in the hearing by Lahari Kommaravelly (helm).
Tobias Matern (coach of GER 3457) attended the hearing as an observer.
K. C. Ganapathy (coach of IND 3407) attended the hearing as an observer.
Ben Greenhalgh (crew of GBR 3513) gave evidence as a witness.
Eswa Suragani (crew of IND 3407) gave evidence as a witness.
GER 3457 provided video evidence during the hearing.
facts: The incident occurred during race 6 of 29er yellow fleet.
The conditions at the moment of the incident were 8 knots of wind with choppy waves.
GER 3457 entered the zone of mark 4p while sailing on a broad reach on starboard tack.
At that moment IND 3407 was sailing on a broad reach on starboard tack clear astern of GER
GER 3457 gybed at less than one boat length from the mark and was now sailing towards it.
IND 3407 gybed and overlapped to windward of GER 3407.
IND 3407 rounded the mark close to it and about 50 centimetres to windward of GER 3457 side by side and then both boats luffed to close-hauled course.
IND 3407 left the mark astern clear ahead of GER 3457.
There was no contact and neither boat took penalty turns.
conclusions: IND 3407 not overlapped with GER 3457 and not in the zone at the time GER 3457 reached the zone, failed to give GER 3457 mark-room, and broke RRS 18.2(a)(2).
IND 3407 to windward failed to keep clear of GER 3457 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
decision: IND 3407 is to be scored DSQ in race 6.
